readiness.insight: The National Weather Service has no active alerts for Fredericksburg. Veterans Day stays sunny near 70 with a light south wind. A slight rain chance arrives late tonight, rises to 50 percent Thursday and Thursday night, then colder northwest wind pushes Friday's high down near 54 with gusts as high as 25 mph.
